query:
SELECT
            LOWER(c.email_address) AS "email!"
        FROM
            email_messages m
        JOIN
            email_message_recipients mr ON m.id = mr.message_id
        JOIN
            email_contacts c ON mr.contact_id = c.id
        WHERE
            m.link_id = $1
            AND m.is_sent = TRUE
            AND m.is_draft = FALSE
        GROUP BY
            LOWER(c.email_address)
        ORDER BY
            COUNT(DISTINCT m.id) DESC,
            LOWER(c.email_address)
        LIMIT $2
